To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the electron gas in an Nb film is a Bose-Einstein gas, that the superconductive electron gas is a superfluid Bose-Einstein gas (i.e., a Bose gas in a superfluid state) and that the superconduction mechanism is a Bose-Einsteinsuperfluidity mechanism.

(1) The electron gas is a statistical system, in the sense that it is characterized by the statistics of the intensity fluctuations of its current; (2) The statistics is the same in normal and superconducting state; (3) The statistics is a Bose-Einstein statistics, in the sense of a Bose-Einstein correlation of the intensity fluctuations.
the intensity fluctuations of an incident beam are correlated to the intensity fluctuations of the two splitted beams, and the intensity fluctuations of two splitted beams are not correlated.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a study of the quantum nature of the electron system in superconductors, and the results are in agreement with the theoretical predictions.

the study of the statistical properties of the electron gas, and in particular with the measurement of the intensity-intensity correlation function, as well as with its application to the investigation of the electron gas properties in a superconducting film.
the study of the statistical nature of a macroscopic system of electrons, i.e. the superconducting electron gas, in the framework of the quantum statistical theory of Bose-Einstein condensates.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the HBT effect has been observed in a superconductive metal.
the electron gas in an Nb film, both in its normal and in its superconductive state, behaves like a gas of bosons.

in the present experiment we have obtained a direct experimental evidence of the statistical nature of a gas of electrons in a superconducting film, by measuring the intensity-fluctuations of the electron gas and the intensity-fluactuations of the electron current.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the HBT experiment is the only experiment that has ever directly measured the statistical nature of a gas of particles.
, by the present experiment, we have demonstrated that the electron gas in superconductor is a gas of particles, and that the superconductor can be regarded as a gas of particles.
we have performed a HBT-type experiment on the electron gas in a superconducting solid.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the case of the electron gas, the HBT experiment has a direct experimental evidence of the statistical nature of a gas of particles, in a solid.
the electron gas of superconductors is a statistical system, as is any other gas of particles.
the statistical nature of a gas of particles is a general property of a gas of any kind of particles.
